brief: How to launch a brand in 7 days — the no-BS playbook.

slots.title: Audit Your Niche
slots.body: Spend one hour mapping competitors and spotting the gap your brand can own. Don't overthink it—just find the white space.

slots.title: Pick Your Vibe
slots.body: Lock in your name, colors, and fonts in one afternoon. Use a simple mood board so everything feels cohesive, not chaotic.

slots.title: Build Your Home Base
slots.body: Set up a one-page website with a clear offer and email capture. Keep the copy punchy and the load time fast.

slots.title: Create Core Content
slots.body: Batch your launch posts, stories, and emails in a single day. Focus on the problem you solve, not just features.

slots.title: Set Up Systems
slots.body: Automate your onboarding, payments, and calendar before you go live. A smooth backend saves you from launch-day panic.

slots.title: Go Live Loud
slots.body: Hit publish and tell everyone why you started. Momentum beats perfection, so ship it and iterate as you grow.

slots.headline: Launch Your Brand This Week
slots.body: Grab the full 7-day checklist and start building today. No fluff, just action.
